name: WholeStack WF-027: Official Permit Code Enforcement Evidence Adapter

parameters.jsCode: const meta=$('Split Permit Sources').item.json; const raw=$json; const status=Number(raw.statusCode||200); let body=raw.body??raw.data??raw; if(typeof body!=='string') body=JSON.stringify(body); let parsed=null; try{parsed=JSON.parse(body);}catch(e){} const rows=parsed?(Array.isArray(parsed)?parsed:(parsed.records||parsed.data||parsed.features||parsed.results||[])):[]; const arr=Array.isArray(rows)?rows:[]; const pick=(a,keys)=>{for(const k of keys){if(a?.[k]!==undefined&&a?.[k]!==null&&String(a[k]).trim()!=='')return a[k];}return null;}; const blobSignal=(a)=>/violation|condemn|unsafe|repair|demolition|substandard|code enforcement|inspection failed|open permit|expired permit|stop work/i.test(JSON.stringify(a)); const records=arr.slice(0,meta.limit).map(r=>{const a=r.attributes&&typeof r.attributes==='object'?r.attributes:r; const signal=blobSignal(a); if(!signal)return null; const permit=pick(a,['permit_number','permit_no','permit_id','record_id','id']); const violation=pick(a,['violation_type','violation','code_violation','violation_description']); const permitStatus=pick(a,['permit_status','status','inspection_status']); return {source_record_id:String(permit||pick(a,['parcel_id','parcelid','pin','pid'])||''),source_url:meta.source.url,source_observed_at:new Date().toISOString(),owner_name:pick(a,['owner_name','owner','party_name']),property_address:pick(a,['property_address','site_address','situs_address','address','location']),parcel_id:pick(a,['parcel_id','parcelid','pin','pid']),signal:meta.criterion,signal_strength:violation||/condemn|unsafe|demolition|stop work/i.test(JSON.stringify(a))?'confirmed':'probable',structured_facts:{permit_number:permit,permit_type:pick(a,['permit_type','type']),permit_status:permitStatus,violation_type:violation,violation_status:pick(a,['violation_status','enforcement_status']),inspection_date:pick(a,['inspection_date','inspection','date']),condition_signal:pick(a,['condition_signal','condition','description']),raw:a},raw_attributes:a};}).filter(Boolean); return [{json:{success:status>=200&&status<300,request_id:meta.request_id,criterion:meta.criterion,source:meta.source,records,limitations:status>=400?['Official permit/code source returned HTTP '+status+'.']:[],missing_fields:records.filter(r=>!r.property_address&&!r.parcel_id).map(r=>r.source_record_id||'unknown'),policy:'Only explicit permit, inspection, violation, condemnation, unsafe-condition, or comparable code-enforcement evidence creates a signal. Missing records are not treated as fixer-upper or distressed.'}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{JSON.stringify({success:true,request_id:$('Prepare Permit Source Requests').first().json.request_id,criterion_results:$input.all().map(i=>i.json),policy:'Permit/code evidence is traceable to the source URL/record and requires downstream review before outreach.'})}}
